title: Preparing a MIPS string syscall
description: You can inspect the prompt setup and the recording's missing entry symbol.

steps.description: The data section stores a null-terminated prompt under msg. You switch to the text section for instructions.
li selects print-string service 4 in $v0. la places the prompt's address in $a0.

steps.question: Does this block define the main label expected by the supplied runner?
steps.answer: No. It supplies the syscall sequence but contains no main label.

steps.description: The sequence is intended to print the prompt when included in a complete program. You instead see an undefined-main diagnostic in the supplied output.
